TRAFFIC ADVISORY

In connection with the 44th India International Trade Fair at Pragati Maidan from 14th to 27th November 2025, traffic congestion is expected on Mathura Road, Bhairon Marg, Ring Road, Shershah Road, and Purana Quila Road. Commuters not visiting the Fair are advised to avoid or bypass these roads for smooth travel.

📍Timings:
-Business Visitors: 14th–18th Nov 2025
-General Public: 19th–27th Nov 2025 (09:30 AM–07:30 PM)

📍Entry Points:
-ITPO Officials: Gate 1 & 9
-Media: Gate 5B
-Visitors: Gate 3, 4, 6 & 10

📍Drop-off & Parking:
-Service lane opposite Gates 3, 4 & 6 (Mathura Road)
-Basement Parking 1 & 2, Bhairon Mandir Parking
-Delhi Zoo Parking

📍Traffic Diversion:
-No halting/parking on Mathura Road & Bhairon Marg
-Visitor vehicles restricted on Sher Shah Rd, Purana Quila Rd, Bhagwan Dass Rd & Tilak Marg

📍Violators will be towed to National Stadium Parking, Gate 5

📍Alternate routes: Outer Ring Road & Tilak Marg C-Hexagon

📍Pedestrian Advisory:
-Heavy foot traffic expected, use foot-over bridges
-Avoid restricted roads if possible

-Use public transport for convenience and safety

📍Stay Updated through Delhi Traffic Police channels

#DPTrafficAdvisory
